scenes.role: Establish Leni’s ordinary goal and the gap between the festival notice and a lived welcome.
actions: Leni notices the empty posts and wants visible bunting.
consequences: Gives the borrowing a purpose; no separate state-changing scene is needed.
prose_obligations: Make the festival imminent and the welcome personal, not abstract.
scenes.implementation_note: Opening motivation is folded into borrow_spool prose; the empty square itself is not an executable encounter.

scenes.role: Borrow the spool for a specific use.
actions: Ask Mrs Bell
Take the spool into Leni’s care
consequences: Leni can use the string; Mrs Bell remains its owner and it must be returned.
prose_obligations: Distinguish borrowing from ownership and make the string useful.
scenes.implementation_note: The promise and physical handoff are one atomic local action.

scenes.role: Clarify the borrowed object’s return and intended use.
prerequisites: Leni has asked to borrow the spool
actions: Mrs Bell says the used string may stay on the display; the spool should come back.
consequences: Sets up the later return with unused string still available.
prose_obligations: Do not treat returned custody as if the string had not been used.
scenes.implementation_note: Consolidated with the handoff rather than represented as a second executable scene.

scenes.role: Introduce the new neighbor and their distinct voice.
prerequisites: Jo has arrived in the village
actions: Leni greets Jo and explains the festival.
consequences: Opens the possibility of collaboration.
prose_obligations: Jo must be a person with a point of view, not a prop for Leni’s virtue.
scenes.implementation_note: Arrival, introduction, and invitation share one short encounter.

scenes.role: Make the no-climbing constraint understandable and specific.
actions: Jo explains that a healing ankle makes climbing unsafe and says they want to help.
consequences: Rules out the arch-as-usual plan without removing Jo’s agency.
prose_obligations: Give the physical restriction an ordinary reason and avoid a rescue trope.
scenes.implementation_note: The motivation is prose grounded in the invitation state; it is not a separate hidden action.

scenes.role: Turn Leni’s task into a shared one.
actions: Leni asks Jo to help choose a display location.
consequences: Jo is invited and can participate in the later layout and tie.
prose_obligations: Show Leni listening rather than deciding everything on Jo’s behalf.
scenes.implementation_note: Meeting and invitation consolidate three reference beats into one enacted local play.

scenes.role: Set up the tempting but unsuitable high display.
prerequisites: Jo has explained the climbing limit
actions: Leni considers climbing to reach the arch.
consequences: Creates a choice between height and safe participation.
prose_obligations: Do not enact or imply that anyone climbs.
scenes.implementation_note: The rejected arch is discussed inside the layout choice; there is no climb action.

scenes.role: Test whether the outdoor low line is actually safe and reachable.
actions: Check weather, post stability, string length, knot security, and Jo’s reach.
consequences: Determines whether the square line or sheltered hall rail is chosen.
prose_obligations: Use understandable physical constraints; do not let a weak post support the line.
scenes.implementation_note: The physical feasibility check and resulting choice form one scene.

scenes.role: Optional characterization vignette in which Jo contributes a memory and design choice.
prerequisites: The layout has not yet been selected
actions: Jo selects blue and gold from the paper triangles.
consequences: The chosen colors persist into the hung display and welcome.
prose_obligations: Let Jo’s history add texture without becoming a prerequisite for helping.
scenes.implementation_note: Optional; omitting it leaves the default red-and-white pattern intact.

scenes.role: Optional practical vignette that may make a slippery knot reliable.
prerequisites: The layout has not yet been selected
actions: Practice a double loop on a short piece of string.
consequences: Consumes ten centimetres and makes the knot secure; remaining length may affect layout.
prose_obligations: Make the practice enacted, useful, and physically accounted for.
scenes.implementation_note: Optional; if omitted, an insecure knot steers the plan away from the exposed square line.

scenes.role: Bring the weather and physical feasibility into the decision.
prerequisites: Leni and Jo are preparing the display
actions: Account for rain, gusts, and exposed or unstable posts.
consequences: Unsafe outdoor conditions select the sheltered rail instead.
prose_obligations: Do not invent rain or wind contrary to the validated parameters.
scenes.implementation_note: Weather is an input to the layout scene, not an unselected scene that fires in the background.

scenes.role: Make the consequential choice to give up the arch or exposed square line.
prerequisites: The display has not been laid out
actions: Choose the low square posts when safe; otherwise carry the basket to the hall rail.
consequences: Sets the actual display location and height.
prose_obligations: Show what is given up and why the alternative is better for both children.
scenes.implementation_note: Outdoor and sheltered results are two local outcomes of one executable scene, not whole-story variants.

scenes.role: Move people and the un-hung bunting when shelter is chosen.
prerequisites: The display is still in its basket
actions: Carry the basket and move Leni and Jo into the hall.
consequences: Keeps character and prop locations continuous.
prose_obligations: Do not teleport the people or bunting between scenes.
scenes.implementation_note: Movement is enacted within the layout scene and changes all affected locations.

scenes.role: Use the borrowed string to put the decorations to work.
scenes.location: low square line or hall rail
prerequisites: A safe, reachable layout is selected
The spool is still with Leni
actions: Tie the bunting using the measured length of string.
consequences: Bunting remains in place and the spool’s remaining length decreases.
prose_obligations: Record the display location, height, and real string use.
scenes.implementation_note: The optional rail hitch, if needed, occurs as a guarded local action in this scene.

scenes.role: Give Jo an active, physically reachable part in the display.
scenes.location: low square line or hall rail
prerequisites: The display is low enough for Jo to reach
actions: Jo ties the final knot from the bench or seated position.
consequences: Jo’s help and increased trust persist into the welcome.
prose_obligations: No climbing, unreachable high line, or merely ceremonial assistance.
scenes.implementation_note: Tying the bunting and Jo’s reachable contribution are committed together so no invalid half-hung state leaks.

scenes.role: Let the display be seen by the arriving village.
actions: Open the festival welcome and greet the first neighbors.
consequences: Jo is welcomed and the shared goal is completed.
prose_obligations: Make the welcome an event, not a promise to welcome people later.
scenes.implementation_note: Arrival and opening are consolidated into one short local play.

scenes.role: Turn preparation into an actual festival welcome.
actions: Open the gathering and greet Jo and the arriving neighbors.
consequences: Festival state, Jo’s welcome, and Leni’s goal change together.
prose_obligations: Keep the welcome in the selected physical location.
scenes.implementation_note: One guarded action records the consequential social outcome.

scenes.role: Show that Jo is joining the community rather than receiving a one-sided gesture.
actions: Jo speaks with neighbors about the display or colors.
consequences: Completes the shared welcome in the reference story.
prose_obligations: Give Jo a voice and a place in the gathering.
scenes.implementation_note: Consolidated as prose in the welcome scene; no separate social action is hidden.

scenes.role: Return the borrowed spool after its useful string remains on the display.
actions: Return the spool with its unused string wound around it.
consequences: Mrs Bell regains custody; display string remains in use.
prose_obligations: Close the borrowing relationship without claiming the used line was unused.
scenes.implementation_note: Custody, location, and returned status change atomically.

scenes.role: Finish with an earned outcome appropriate to the selected display.
actions: Complete the shared-square or sheltered-hall ending.
consequences: The adventure ends with a concrete, completed welcome.
prose_obligations: Make both outcomes emotionally complete; do not leave the welcome as a future plan.
scenes.implementation_note: Two executable outcomes share this reference encounter; the chosen location determines the compatible ending.
